text:
I've been trying Seedance 2.0 inside CapCut for a bit and here's my thougts:

The generation speed is faster than i expect

The generate and edit workflow is smooth

The new web-based product Video Studio allows AI-native workflow on an unlimited canvas and support omni reference, this is the killer part.

Find seedance 2.0 in these CapCut models:
→ Web: Video Studio (omni reference supported)
→ Desktop: Media -> AI Video (t2v, i2v supported)
→ App: AI Lab, AI Generator, AI Video (t2v, i2v supported)
content:
Use CapCut Web → Video Studio to access Seedance 2.0 with omni reference on an unlimited canvas for an AI-native generate-and-edit workflow  
Use CapCut Desktop → Media → AI Video to run Seedance 2.0 text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v)  
Use CapCut App → AI Lab / AI Generator / AI Video to run Seedance 2.0 text-to-video (t2v) and image-to-video (i2v)

translations.es:

Usa CapCut Desktop → Media → AI Video para ejecutar Seedance 2.0 de texto a video (t2v) e imagen a video (i2v)  
Usa CapCut App → AI Lab / AI Generator / AI Video para ejecutar Seedance 2.0 de texto a video (t2v) e imagen a video (i2v)
